exposure: conventional methods for diagnosing CNS infection
cohort: Neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) with a suspected Central Nervous System (CNS) infection.
finding: Combining metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) with whole exome sequencing (WES) significantly improved the diagnostic rate of the etiology for suspected neonatal CNS infections and effectively guided clinical strategies.
